poller.guardDeclRe: let attempts = 0;\s*let cancelled = false;\s*(?://[^\n]*\n\s*)*let refreshedOn404 = false;
poller.why: Codi FINAL pre-merge: refresh-loop guard. If the server-side isBookingNotFound lookup throws it returns false and the page renders the poller again; without a guard every 404 would refresh again. The flag lives in the polling effect beside attempts (the effect's existing per-mount state; router.refresh() keeps the poller instance, so the flag survives the refresh). The first 404 refreshes once and keeps polling (if the server now renders not-found the poller unmounts and cleanup stops it); a second 404 ends in the existing timed-out state. No new copy.
